Grabbit adds a **Download** button to videos, audio and images on any website, including YouTube, Instagram, X, TikTok, Reddit, Facebook, Vimeo and [1,800+ more](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/supportedsites.md). Files go straight to your Downloads folder.

## What's new in 1.2

- **Grabbit for Android.** In YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Chrome or any other app, tap **Share › Grabbit**, pick a quality, and the file goes to Downloads/Grabbit. It runs the same download engine as the desktop app, right on the phone, with no account and nothing sent anywhere else.
  - Private, follower-only and age-restricted videos: sign in to Instagram, X, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit or Vimeo once inside Grabbit.
  - Images too: in Chrome, long-press an image › **Share image** › **Save with Grabbit**.
  - Downloads keep going with the screen off, and Grabbit keeps its download engine up to date by itself.
- The Mac and Windows apps are unchanged apart from their download engine.

## Download

| Your computer | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac with an Apple chip (M1 or later) | `Grabbit-…-mac-apple-silicon.dmg` |
| Mac with an Intel processor | `Grabbit-…-mac-intel.dmg` |
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | `Grabbit-Setup-….exe` |
| Android 10 or later | `Grabbit-…-android.apk` (older 32-bit phones: `Grabbit-…-android-32bit.apk`) |

Not sure which Mac you have? Open the Apple menu › **About This Mac**. "Chip: Apple M…" means Apple chip; "Processor: … Intel" means Intel.

## Install

**Mac**
1. Open the .dmg and drag **Grabbit** into **Applications**, then open it from there.
2. The first time, macOS says it can't check Grabbit for malware (it isn't signed with a paid Apple developer account). Click **Done**, open **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**, then confirm.

**Windows**
1. Run `Grabbit-Setup-….exe`. If you see "Windows protected your PC", click **More info › Run anyway**.
2. Click **Finish** with "Open Grabbit" ticked.

**Android**
1. On the phone, open this page and download `Grabbit-…-android.apk`.
2. Open the downloaded file. Android asks whether your browser may install apps: allow it.
3. If Play Protect says it doesn't recognise the app, tap **More details › Install anyway**. Grabbit isn't on Google Play, which doesn't allow YouTube downloaders.
4. Then, in any app, tap **Share › Grabbit**.

**Then, on Mac and Windows:** a setup page opens in your browser. Follow its three steps to add the Download button to Chrome, Edge or Brave. It takes about 30 seconds and only needs doing once.

Grabbit then runs quietly in the menu bar (Mac) or system tray (Windows), starts when you log in, and keeps its download engine (yt-dlp) up to date by itself.

DRM-protected video (Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Spotify) can't be downloaded. Please respect each site's terms and copyright.
